PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED MAY-26-2023, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT COMCAST OF ALAMEDA, INC.,DBA XFINITY
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) JOSE SAINZ, TECH OPS SUPERVISOR. FILED BY DEFENDANT COMCAST OF ALAMEDA, INC.,DBA XFINITY

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-12-2023 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO OCT-12-2023 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF JAMES WESSER IS PRESENT VIA UNAUTHORIZED ZOOM BY PHONE DIAL IN. PLAINTIFF MARGARET WESSER IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT COMCAST OF ALAMEDA, INC. DBA XFINITY IS PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY JOSE SAINZ (TECH OPS SUPERVISOR). PLAINTIFF JAMES WESSER INFORMS THE COURT THE REASON OF HIS UNAUTHORIZED ZOOM DIAL IN IS DUE TO MEDICAL EMERGENCY AND PARTIES HAD ALREADY REACHED A SETTLEMENT PRIOR TO HEARING, AND HE HAS RECEIVED THE SETTLEMENT CHECK FROM DEFENDANT BUT THAT HASN'T BEEN DEPOSIT YET. PLAINTIFF REQUESTS THE COURT FOR MORE TIME TO MONITOR THE DEPOSIT OF THE CHECK STATUS. PROGRESS REPORT SET FOR OCTOBER-12, 2023 AT 3:30 P.M. IN DEPT 506. IF THERE IS NO APPEARANCE BY ANY PARTY, THEN CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE ("DWP"). IF THERE IS AN APPEARANCE, HEARING WILL BE CONDUCTED FOR JUDGEMENT DECISION. PLAINTIFF MAY SUBMIT DISMISSAL TO THE COURT BEFORE THE NEXT COURT DATE IF SETTLED TO TAKE THE CASE OFF CALENDAR. NO HEARING OCCURED. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: WILLIAM LYNN; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER CASE CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)
DISMISSAL OF ENTIRE ACTION OF ALL PARTIES AND ALL CAUSES OF ACTION WITH PREJUDICE CLAIM HEARING OF OCT-12-2023 OFF CALENDAR, DISMISSAL FILED
